gaps.finding: Canonical HSK1 has no unit, lesson, grammar, character or assessment records.
gaps.remediation: Author the C1 level graph and all referenced learning objects.

gaps.finding: 300/300 vocabulary translations remain machine-assisted; human-reviewed count is zero.
gaps.remediation: Human review meanings, usage, examples and translations before production.

gaps.finding: Context meanings, collocations and common Vietnamese-learner errors have zero coverage.
gaps.remediation: Enrich by pedagogic priority and validate against authoritative dictionaries/corpora.

gaps.finding: 900 sentences are structurally valid but template-assisted; prior duplicate gate flags 233 near-review items.
gaps.remediation: Assign sentences to lessons, dependency-check them and manually review a representative sample before use.

gaps.finding: Canonical vocabulary has no owned audio references; runtime falls back to browser speech synthesis.
gaps.remediation: Create an audio script/manifest and reviewed recordings or explicitly licensed TTS assets.

gaps.finding: No canonical diagnostic, unit, mid, final, speaking or writing assessment exists.
gaps.remediation: Author original assessment blueprints and rubrics aligned to current CTI tasks.

gaps.finding: Current UI mixes lesson data/rendering and limits persisted selectable levels to 0–4.
gaps.remediation: Only after content exists, add a content adapter and learner-facing unit navigation without expanding Developer Center.

gaps.finding: Canonical level shells are empty; legacy HSK2–4 are thin and HSK5–9 have no learning content.
gaps.remediation: Build level-by-level after C1 gates; never fill with placeholders.

gaps.finding: HSK 3.0 is in a 2026 transition; regular test status must be rechecked before release.
gaps.remediation: Revisit CTI notice/calendar at every level release.

findings: Translations still require human Vietnamese review.
Sentence candidates need lesson dependency and naturalness review.

limitations: Lesson data and renderer are coupled in one global file.
Quiz primarily checks word-meaning recognition and uses generated distractors without rationales.
Browser speechSynthesis is not a reviewed audio curriculum.

scope: Current HSK content, schemas, runtime learning journey, source coverage and C0 architecture. No user data or production curriculum changed.

sourceAudit.copyrightRule: No commercial textbook/test content copied; architecture paraphrases public standards and requires original VDuckie teaching content.

strengths.evidence: 300 HSK1 vocabulary records follow the current CTI syllabus order with row locators.
Stable IDs, six vocabulary shards, nine sentence shards, checksums and sourceRefs are present.
Production includes pronunciation foundation, vocabulary, writing animation, grammar, reading, dictation, quiz and mobile step navigation.
Canonical curriculum remains developer-only/read-only; production and public override are locked.
